items.title_zh: 算力扩容倒逼电力迭代，储能增量空间打开，业内预计全固态电池2035年规模化可期
items.body_zh: 算力狂飙之下，储能的价值边界正在被重新定义。近日在宁波举行的第13届中国（宁波）电池新能源产业国际高峰论坛（ABEC 2026）上，由算力浪潮催生的人工智能数据中心（AIDC）配储赛道成为全场焦点。与会专家认为，AIDC BBU电芯正迎来认证卡位窗口期，算力需求抬升倒逼电力配套迭代，为储能打开全新增量空间。在此背景下，全固态电池大规模商业化有望在2035年到来。（上证报）
items.title_en: The expansion of computing power is driving the iteration of power supply, opening up room for energy storage growth. The industry expects all-solid-state batteries to achieve scale production by 2035.
items.body_en: Amid the surge in computing power, the value boundaries of energy storage are being redefined. At the 13th China (Ningbo) International Summit Forum on the Battery and New Energy Industry (ABEC 2026) held recently in Ningbo, the Artificial Intelligence Data Center (AIDC) energy storage sector, spurred by the surge in computing power, became the focal point of the event. The experts at the conference believe that AIDC BBU cells are entering a window period for certification positioning, and the rising demand for computing power is forcing the iteration of power support systems, opening up new incremental space for energy storage. Against this backdrop, the large-scale commercialization of all-solid-state batteries is expected to arrive in 2035. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_en: Peru raises interest rates for the first time in nearly four years.
items.body_en: Peru has raised interest rates for the first time in nearly four years to curb soaring inflation triggered by rising food and energy prices. On Thursday local time, Peru's PBOC raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.50%, in line with most analysts' expectations.

items.title_zh: A股分红回购持续加码，投资者回报机制加快完善

items.title_en: A-share dividends and share buybacks continue to increase, and the investor return mechanism is being improved at an accelerated pace.
items.body_en: On October 19, authoritative sources disclosed that since the beginning of this year, A-share listed companies have paid out 2.1 trillion yuan in dividends and share buybacks, which is 2.7 times the amount of IPO financing and refinancing during the same period. Industry insiders say that this data indicates that the capital market is accelerating its shift towards a virtuous cycle of dynamic balance between investment and financing. As the intensity of dividends and share buybacks continues to increase, the investor return mechanism will be accelerated and improved, the investment value of listed companies will steadily rise, and the foundation for the stable and long-term development of the capital market will be further strengthened. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_en: The yield on 2/10-year U.S. Treasury bonds fell by over 12 basis points, and traders increased their bets on the Federal Reserve's interest rate hike outlook.
items.body_en: On Thursday (November 12, after the holiday), at the close of trading in New York, the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose by 12.09 basis points to 5.1129%. From the start of the Asia-Pacific session until 20:00 Beijing time, it remained largely flat, trading in a narrow range around 4.99%. Subsequently, it continued to rise (due to Trump's comments on Iran + a sell-off in tech stocks). The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose by 12.68 basis points to 4.8645%. It gapped up at the start of Asia-Pacific trading and continued to trade around 4.76%, with the increase steadily expanding from 20:45. The underwriting banks have informed potential investors that Anthropic will prioritize the needs of existing investors, and some prospective buyers will receive a smaller allocation than they anticipated.

items.title_en: Chile raises lithium production forecast, market expected to return to oversupply next year.
items.body_en: Chile has raised its lithium production forecast for this year, even though slowing demand growth and rising supply are expected to push the global market back into oversupply in 2027. Chile, the world's third-largest lithium producer, will produce about 325,000 tons of lithium carbonate equivalent (LCE) in 2026, up from the 305,000 tons forecast a year ago, the Chilean National Copper Commission (Cochilco) said on Thursday. Production is expected to rise to 335,000 tons in 2027. Driven by the rapid growth of battery energy storage systems, global lithium demand is expected to increase by 25% this year to 2.08 million tons, approximately 34% higher than Cochilco's forecast from a year ago.

story.title_zh: 省下一滴焊料的人，成了首富
story.title_en: The Man Who Saved One Drop of Solder
story.body_zh: 洛克菲勒参观自家炼油厂，问工人焊一个油桶用几滴焊料。答：四十滴。他让人试试三十八滴，一滴不漏。就为这两滴，工厂每年省下大笔钱。他说：巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真。
story.body_en: Young Rockefeller once watched workers seal oil barrels. He asked how many drops of solder each barrel took. Forty, they said. He asked them to try thirty-eight. Not a single barrel leaked. His ledgers went to three decimal places. Great wealth comes from great attention to small things.

lines.en: Ohio, eighteen seventy. A quiet man in a dark suit is watching workers seal oil barrels, one by one.
lines.zh: 俄亥俄，1870 年。一个穿黑西装的安静男人，正看着工人们一个一个焊接油桶。

lines.en: How many drops of solder does one barrel take?
lines.zh: 焊一个桶，要用几滴焊料？

lines.en: Forty drops, sir. Same as always.
lines.zh: 四十滴，先生。一直都是四十滴。

lines.en: Try thirty-eight.
lines.zh: 试试三十八滴。

lines.en: They tried. Not a single barrel leaked. Those two drops saved the plant real money, every single year.
lines.zh: 工人们试了。一滴都没漏。就这两滴，每年给工厂省下真金白银。

lines.en: Great wealth comes from great attention to small things. Saved one drop at a time.
lines.zh: 巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真，一滴一滴攒出来的。

joke.title_zh: 邻居失业叫衰退，自己失业叫萧条
joke.title_en: A Recession Is When Your Neighbor Loses His Job
joke.body_zh: 据说杜鲁门总统这样区分经济术语：邻居失业，叫衰退；自己失业，才叫萧条。一句话戳破了宏大叙事——经济数据再漂亮，落到每个具体的人身上，感受是完全不同的。这也提醒我们读新闻时留个心眼：报表上的百分比，都是别人的人生。理解经济，要从理解一个具体的人开始。
joke.body_en: President Truman supposedly explained economic terms this way. A recession is when your neighbor loses his job. A depression is when you lose yours. One sentence, and all the big words collapse. Growth rates look beautiful on paper. But every percentage point is somebody's real life. It is a good habit when reading the news. Behind every statistic, there is a person. Economics starts with people, not charts.

items.title_en: Expectations of U.S. interest rate hikes intensify, institutions gauge the direction of gold prices.
items.body_en: The latest inflation data released by the United States exceeded market expectations, not only reinforcing market expectations of a hawkish stance on the Federal Reserve's monetary policy but also causing an adjustment in international gold prices, which fell below the $4,100/ounce mark. Institutions such as Goldman Sachs have recently lowered their gold price targets. However, some analysts argue that global demand for gold purchases and reserve diversification by the PBOC still provides structural support for gold. Short-term pressure coexists with medium- to long-term fundamentals, and the market is entering an observation window where bullish and bearish factors are intertwined. (China Securities Journal).

I believe we need to be very cautious, as the ultimate returns on these investments may not fully meet previous expectations. This has evolved from a stock-based narrative to a balance sheet-based narrative.

story.title_zh: 把银行家锁进书房，直到他们答应救市
story.title_en: The Night He Locked the Bankers In
story.body_zh: 一九〇七年十月纽约股市崩盘，没有央行兜底的美国眼看滑向恐慌。六十九岁的摩根把几十位银行总裁锁进书房，逼出两千五百万美元救市资金，凌晨签下协议，恐慌停了。五年后美联储成立。
story.body_en: In October nineteen oh seven, New York was in panic. America had no central bank. J.P. Morgan, sixty-nine years old, summoned bank presidents to his library and locked the doors. The deal was signed after midnight. The panic stopped. Five years later, the Federal Reserve was born.

lines.en: New York, October, nineteen oh seven. Depositors are lining up in the streets. America has no central bank, and the panic is spreading.
lines.zh: 纽约，1907 年 10 月。储户在街头排起长队。美国没有央行，恐慌正在蔓延。

lines.en: So the most powerful banker in America did something nobody would dare today.
lines.zh: 于是，全美最有权势的银行家做了一件今天没人敢做的事。

lines.en: Gentlemen, you will all come to my library tonight. Bring your real numbers, not the ones for newspapers.
lines.zh: 诸位，今晚都到我的书房来。带上真实的账目，别带给报纸看的那份。

lines.en: He questioned each president one by one, behind closed doors, until the true holes were on the table.
lines.zh: 他关门一个个逼问各位总裁，直到真实的窟窿全部摆上桌面。

lines.en: It is almost twelve o'clock. Nobody leaves this room until the papers are signed.
lines.zh: 现在快十二点了。文件不签完，谁也别想出这个门。

lines.en: After midnight, twenty-five million dollars was pledged. The panic stopped. Five years later, partly because of this night, the Federal Reserve was born.
lines.zh: 午夜过后，两千五百万美元的救市资金凑齐了。恐慌停了。五年后，正因为这一夜，美联储诞生了。

joke.title_zh: 银行家为什么辞职？他失去了“利息”
joke.title_en: Why Did the Banker Quit? He Lost Interest
joke.body_zh: 一位年轻银行家在大银行干满一年就辞职了。朋友都问他为什么，他只说了一句：我失去了利息。这个笑话妙在双关。英文里利息和兴趣是同一个词。对银行家来说，这两样东西缺一样都干不下去。所以下次见到闷闷不乐的银行家，你可以关心地问一句：是利息的问题，还是兴趣的问题？
joke.body_en: A young banker worked at a big bank for exactly one year. Then he quit. His friends all asked why. He gave them a one line answer. I lost interest. The joke works in two ways. In English, the money a bank pays you, and the feeling of caring, are the same word. A banker cannot survive without either one. So next time you meet a sad banker, ask politely. Is it the interest, or the interest?

story.title_zh: 最自信的一年，他差点赔光一切
story.title_en: The Year of Total Confidence Nearly Ruined Him
story.body_zh: 一九八二年，达利欧公开判断美国经济将走向萧条并重仓押注。结果墨西哥违约后市场不跌反涨，公司只剩他一个人。他从此写下每笔决策的依据，把痛苦变成算法，后来的桥水成了全球最大对冲基金。
story.body_en: In nineteen eighty-two, Ray Dalio predicted a depression, loudly and publicly. Then Mexico defaulted, and markets rose instead of falling. His company shrank to one person: himself. From then on, he logged every decision. Pain became an algorithm. That log built Bridgewater, the largest hedge fund in the world.

lines.en: Nineteen eighty-two. A young trader goes on television, and says the word everyone fears. Depression.
lines.zh: 1982 年。一个年轻交易员上电视，说出了所有人害怕的那个词：萧条。

lines.en: I am completely certain. The economy is going down. I have bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 我非常确定，经济要往下走。我把全部身家都押上了。

lines.en: Then Mexico defaulted. And the market did the one thing he did not expect. It rose.
lines.zh: 然后，墨西哥违约了。市场做了他唯一没料到的事：上涨。

lines.en: Ray, you have to close the company. You have lost everything.
lines.zh: 瑞，你得把公司关了，你什么都赔光了。

lines.en: I have four thousand dollars left, borrowed from my father. And one employee. Me.
lines.zh: 我还剩向我爸借的四千美元，和一个员工——我自己。

lines.en: He later called it the most valuable event of his life. From then on, he wrote down the reason behind every decision. Every mistake was logged and studied. Pain became an algorithm.
lines.zh: 他后来称这次经历是一生中最宝贵的。从那以后，他把每个决策的依据都写下来，每个错误都记录归档。痛苦，变成了算法。

joke.title_zh: 杯子半满？工程师说杯子太大了
joke.title_en: Half Full? The Engineer Says the Glass Is Too Big
joke.body_zh: 乐观主义者说杯子是半满的，悲观主义者说是半空的，工程师看了看说：这个杯子比实际需要的大了一倍。放到市场里也一样：同一个行情，多头看到机会，空头看到风险，而真正干活的人只关心一件事——估值和实际价值差多少。别急着站队，先量一量杯子。
joke.body_en: The optimist says the glass is half full. The pessimist says it is half empty. The engineer looks at both and says, the glass is twice as big as it needs to be. Markets work the same way. The bull sees opportunity. The bear sees risk. The person doing the actual work asks only one question. How far is the price from the real value? Do not rush to pick a side. First, measure the glass.

items.body_zh: 本周这份备受关注的消费者价格指数（CPI）报告将缺少一项关键数字：12个月同比变化。 通常，美国劳工统计局（BLS）的CPI报告会同时显示价格较上月和较去年同期的变化。后者——9月为3.7%——通常是公众理解通胀的主要口径。 由于2025年政府停摆，周二发布的10月数据将不提供这一指标。 停摆导致BLS未能采集2025年10月的部分价格数据，且该机构无法事后追溯补采这些数据。
items.title_en: The Trump Administration will not release year-over-year data for U.S. October CPI vs. core CPI.
items.body_en: This week's closely watched Consumer Price Index (CPI) report will be missing a key figure: 12-month year-on-year changes. Typically, the CPI report from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) shows both price changes from the previous month and year-over-year. The latter - 3.7% in September - is often the main calibre for public understanding of inflation. Due to the government shutdown in 2025, the October data released on Tuesday will not provide this indicator. The shutdown caused BLS to fail to collect some of the October 2025 price data, and the agency was unable to retroactively make up for the data.

story.title_zh: 一夜之间，与英格兰银行对赌的人
story.title_en: The Night He Bet Against the Bank of England
story.body_zh: 一九九二年，英镑被固定汇率锁在偏高的位置。索罗斯判断英国撑不住。九月十六日英国一天加息两次仍挡不住卖盘，当晚英镑暴跌。他的基金净赚约十亿美元，报纸标题写着打垮了英格兰银行。
story.body_en: In nineteen ninety-two, the British pound was locked into a fixed exchange rate that was too high. On September sixteenth, Britain raised rates twice in one day. It was not enough. That evening, the pound crashed. His fund made about one billion dollars.

lines.en: London, September, nineteen ninety-two. Black Wednesday is only hours away.
lines.zh: 伦敦，1992 年 9 月。距离黑色星期三，只剩几个小时了。

lines.en: George, the Bank of England keeps defending the pound. Rates went up again this morning.
lines.zh: 乔治，英格兰银行还在死守英镑，今天上午又加息了。

lines.en: A weak economy cannot defend an overvalued currency forever. Increase the position.
lines.zh: 疲软的经济，守不住高估的货币。继续加仓。

lines.en: All of it? This is the Bank of England we are betting against.
lines.zh: 全部押上？我们赌的对手可是英格兰银行。

lines.en: When a trade is right, go for the jugular.
lines.zh: 当一笔交易是对的，就要直取要害。

lines.en: That evening Britain gave up, and the pound crashed out of the system. His fund made about one billion dollars. Newspapers said he broke the Bank of England.
lines.zh: 当晚，英国投降了，英镑暴跌退出汇率机制。他的基金净赚约十亿美元。报纸标题写着：他打垮了英格兰银行。

joke.title_zh: 牛市赚钱，熊市赚钱，猪被宰
joke.title_en: Bulls Win, Bears Win, Pigs Get Slaughtered
joke.body_zh: 华尔街有句老话：牛市能赚钱，熊市也能赚钱，只有猪会被宰。牛是看涨的人，熊是看跌的人，猪是指贪得无厌的人。这句话的重点不是让你判断方向，而是提醒你：方向从来不是死因，贪心才是。涨了还想更多，亏了想一夜翻本，这类动作才最危险。行情永远都在，本金没了就真的没了。
joke.body_en: Wall Street has an old chant. Bulls make money. Bears make money. Pigs get slaughtered. Bulls expect prices to rise. Bears expect prices to fall. And pigs are the greedy ones. The lesson is not about picking a direction. Direction is rarely what kills an account. Greed is. Holding for more when you are up. Doubling down to win it all back overnight. Markets are always open. But lost capital does not come back.

items.body_zh: 微软公司正逐步终止向甲骨文公司租用人工智能（AI）算力的安排，这是其对价值数十亿美元的云合作伙伴关系进行更大范围重估的一部分。 据知情人士透露，近几个月来，微软在拒绝续约后，已开始陆续关闭从甲骨文租用的算力。随着时间推移，微软租用的这批算力变得不再好用，因为它已不再符合公司的规格要求。他们称，甲骨文这批硬件使用的是英伟达较旧一代的芯片。
items.title_en: Report: Deprecated chips are not new enough, Microsoft is winding down arrangements to lease AI cloud power from Oracle.
items.body_en: Microsoft is winding down its arrangement to lease artificial intelligence (AI) computing power from Oracle as part of a broader revaluation of its multi-billion-dollar cloud partnership. In recent months, Microsoft has begun shutting down the computing power leased from Oracle after refusing to renew the contract, according to people familiar with the matter. Over time, this batch of computing power rented by Microsoft has become no longer easy to use because it no longer meets the company's specifications. The Oracle hardware, they say, uses older Nvidia chips.

items.title_zh: 何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话
items.body_zh: 北京时间11月6日晚，中美经贸中方牵头人、国务院副总理何立峰与美方牵头人、美国财政部长贝森特和贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话。双方围绕落实好中美元首北京和华盛顿会晤重要共识和经贸磋商成果，就彼此关心的重要经贸问题进行了坦诚、深入、建设性的交流。中方就近期美对华经贸限制措施表达严正关切。
items.title_en: He Lifeng held a video call with Besent, Director of the Ministry of Finance of the United States, and Trade Representative Greer.
items.body_en: On the evening of November 6, Beijing time, the Chinese leader of China-US economic and trade, the Vice Premier of the State Council, He Lifeng, held a video call with the US leader, the Director of the Ministry of Finance of the United States, Besent, and Trade Representative Greer. The two sides had frank, in-depth and constructive exchanges on important economic and trade issues of mutual concern around the implementation of the important consensus reached at the China-US Summit in Beijing and Washington, D.C., and the outcomes of the economic and trade consultations. The Chinese side expressed serious concerns about the recent restrictions on US trade with China.

items.title_zh: 国际金价在非农日走低，本周累涨5%，纽约铜本周跌3.8%
items.body_zh: 周五（11月6日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金跌0.4%，报4071.39美元/盎司，亚太早盘曾短暂地微幅上涨，北京时间09:17以来持续处于下跌状态，21:30发布美国非农就业报告时显著下跌、刷新日低至4028.49美元，本周累计上涨5.06%，11月4-5日（至亚太中午）持续扩大涨幅、11:30达到4146.97美元。 COMEX黄金期货累涨4.65%，报4080.10美元/盎司。
items.title_en: International gold prices fell on off-farm days, rising 5% this week, and copper in New York fell 3.8% this week.
items.body_en: At the end of New York on Friday (November 6), spot gold fell 0.4% to $4,071.39 per ounce. The Asia-Pacific morning market had briefly risen slightly, and it has continued to decline since 09:17 Beijing time. At 21:30, the US non-farm payroll employment report fell significantly, refreshing as low as $4,028.49, rising 5.06% this week. On November 4-5 (until midday in Asia-Pacific), the increase continued to expand, reaching $4,146.97 at 11:30. COMEX gold futures were up 4.65% at $4080.10/oz.

items.title_zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）
items.body_zh: 11月3日当周，投机者所持COMEX黄金净多头头寸减少3,107手合约，至104,297手合约，创最近21周新低；多头绝对值123,437手合约，创大约七个月新低。 所持COMEX白银净多头头寸降低至2,665手合约，创约三年来新低。 所持COMEX铜净多头头寸减少至34,444手合约，创逾14个月新低。 转而持有NYMEX铂金净空头头寸1,076手合约，创最近逾17个月新高。
items.title_en: Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
items.body_en: During the week of November 3, speculators' net long positions in COMEX gold decreased by 3,107 contracts to 104,297 contracts, hitting a new low in the last 21 weeks; the absolute value of long contracts was 123,437 contracts, hitting a new low of about seven months. The net long position in COMEX silver was reduced to 2,665 contracts, a three-year low. The COMEX copper net long position was reduced to 34,444 lots, a record low of more than 14 months. Switched to the NYMEX platinum net short position of 1,076 lots, a recent high of more than 17 months.

items.title_zh: 伊拉克外长表示，美国财政部要求伊拉克关闭与伊朗的大部分边境口岸，仅保留两个开放
items.body_zh: 伊拉克外长表示，美国财政部要求伊拉克关闭与伊朗的大部分边境口岸，仅保留两个开放
items.title_en: Iraq's Foreign Minister says the U.S. Ministry of Finance is demanding that Iraq close most of its border crossings with Iran, leaving only two open.
items.body_en: Iraq's Foreign Minister says the U.S. Ministry of Finance is demanding that Iraq close most of its border crossings with Iran, leaving only two open.

items.title_zh: 美国多名国会议员说将推动撤销不合理关税政策
items.body_zh: 11月7日消息，鉴于美国选民对高生活成本和高通胀反应强烈，随着民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，多名民主党籍国会议员表示将致力于推动撤销现行的不合理关税政策。尽管这些民主党籍国会议员表达了推动撤销不合理关税措施的意愿，但也有分析认为，虽然民主党在中期选举中获得国会参议院和众议院的控制权，但美国总统特朗普可以通过对国会立法行使否决权等进行有效制衡，现有关税措施短期内或难以出现实质性松动。（新华社）
items.title_en: US lawmakers say they will push for the removal of unjustified tariffs.
items.body_en: On Nov. 7, as voters reacted strongly to the high cost of living and high inflation in the United States and as Democrats scored a landslide victory in the midterm elections, a number of Democratic lawmakers expressed their commitment to pushing for the removal of the current unjustified tariffs. Although these Democratic members of Congress have expressed their willingness to push for the withdrawal of unreasonable tariff measures, some analysts believe that although Democrats have gained control of the Senate and House of Representatives in the mid-term elections, US President Trump can effectively check and balance the existing tariff measures by exercising veto power over Congressional legislation, etc. It may be difficult to see substantive loosening in the short term. (Xinhua News Agency).

items.title_zh: 香港证监会收紧误导性称衔，降低投资者误判风险
items.body_zh: 11月6日，香港证券及期货事务监察委员会发表咨询总结，就进一步限制不受规管的机构使用具误导性的名称以保障投资者，相关修订建议获市场广泛支持。香港证监会表示，将扩大受限制称衔清单，并建立更快更新清单的机制，同时把监管覆盖延伸至虚拟资产领域，从源头减少投资者因机构名称产生误判，夯实投资者保护防线。
items.title_en: Hong Kong's the CSRC tightens misleading titles to reduce the risk of investor misjudgment.
items.body_en: On November 6, the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission issued an advisory summary on further restricting the use of misleading names by unregulated institutions to protect investors. The relevant amendment proposal was widely supported by the market. The CSRC in Hong Kong said it would expand the list of restricted titles and establish a mechanism to update the list more quickly, while extending regulatory coverage to the virtual asset sector, reducing investor misjudgment due to institutional names from the source, and strengthening investor protection lines.

items.title_zh: 中信建投：维持对北美算力和国产AI算力产业链长期看好
items.body_zh: 中信建投证券发布通信行业2027年度投资策略报告称，大模型商业化在2026年快速扩张，截至2026年9月底，OpenAI和Anthropic两家ARR合计约1240亿美元。北美四大CSP厂商2026年第三季度合计资本开支约2087亿美元，同比增长84.2%，AI基础设施投资保持高强度。
items.title_en: CITIC Construction and Investment: Maintain long-term optimism about the North American hashrate and domestic AI hashrate industry chain.
items.body_en: CITIC Securities released the 2027 Annual Investment Strategy Report of the Communications Industry, saying that the commercialization of the large model expanded rapidly in 2026, and as of the end of September 2026, the combined ARRs of OpenAI and Anthropic were about $124 billion. The four largest CSP vendors in North America have a total capital expenditure of about 208.7 billion US dollars in the third quarter of 2026, up year on year 84.2%, and AI infrastructure investment remains strong.

items.title_zh: AI辅助设计禽流感疫苗动物实验获进展
items.body_zh: 英国剑桥大学日前发布公报说，该校团队借助人工智能（AI）设计的一种新型广谱禽流感疫苗，在动物实验中对多种禽流感病毒变异株展现出防护效力。这款候选疫苗由剑桥大学与其衍生企业共同研发。研究人员收集全球监测项目记录的禽流感病毒基因序列数据，利用AI工具整合分析，设计出一系列包含这类病毒共同抗原特征的“超级抗原”。
items.title_en: Advances in AI-assisted design of animal experiments for avian influenza vaccines.
items.body_en: A new broad-spectrum avian influenza vaccine designed by the artificial intelligence (AI) team has shown protective efficacy against a variety of avian influenza virus variants in animal experiments, the University of Cambridge said in a communique recently. The vaccine candidate was jointly developed by the University of Cambridge and its derivatives. The researchers collected the avian influenza virus gene sequence data recorded by the global surveillance project, and used AI tools to integrate and analyze them to design a series of "superantigens" containing the common antigen characteristics of such viruses.

items.title_zh: 伊拉克外长
items.body_zh: 伊拉克已与美国达成谅解，允许石油通过霍尔木兹海峡经靠近阿曼的航道出口，出口业务仍在持续进行。 伊拉克因伊朗战争及石油出口业务中断造成的损失已达600亿美元。
items.title_en: Minister for Foreign Affairs of Iraq.
items.body_en: Iraq has reached an understanding with the United States to allow oil to be exported through the Strait of Hormuz via a waterway close to Oman, and export operations continue. Iraq has suffered $60 billion in damages as a result of the war in Iran and the disruption of its oil export business.

items.title_zh: 乌方称俄军袭击致多地紧急停电
items.body_zh: 乌克兰国家电力公司8日在社交媒体发文称，俄军对乌能源基础设施的持续袭击导致乌电网面临严峻困难，哈尔科夫州、苏梅州和波尔塔瓦州当天紧急停电。乌私营能源企业DTEK公司8日在社交媒体发文称，基辅市和基辅州当天上午再次紧急停电。该公司称，第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州再次遭到大规模袭击，巴甫洛格勒等地超过60万居民断电。
items.title_en: The Ukrainian side said that the Russian attack caused emergency power outages in many places.
items.body_en: The Ukrainian State Electricity Corporation said in a social media post on the 8th that the Ukrainian power grid faced serious difficulties due to the continuous attacks of the Russian military on the energy infrastructure of Ukraine, and the emergency power outages in Kharkiv, Samui and Poltava oblasts on the same day. Ukrainian private energy company DTEK said in a social media post on the 8th that Kiev City and Kiev State again had an emergency power outage that morning. The company said that Dnipropetrovsk Oblast was again hit by a large-scale attack, and more than 600,000 residents in Pavlograd and other places lost power.

items.title_zh: 进博会上海交易团意向成交额连续8年居全国地方交易团第一
items.body_zh: 上海市政府副秘书长、上海交易团副团长朱民指出，历经九载发展，进博会成交与首发成果丰硕，上海交易团意向成交额已连续八年居全国地方交易团第一，本届展会规模再创新高，而大型零售采购商联盟作为上海交易团重要组成部分，会员已从成立之初21家发展至45家，践行着“在上海、买全球、卖全球”。一批重点采购项目代表进行现场推介，聚焦进口优质消费品引进，充分释放进博会溢出效应。据不完全统计，本届进博会上零售联盟已达成72个采购意向。
items.title_en: Expo Shanghai Trading Group's intention to turnover ranked first in the national local trading group for 8 consecutive years.
items.body_en: Zhu Min, deputy secretary-general of the Shanghai Municipal Government and deputy head of the Shanghai Trading Group, pointed out that after nine years of development, the transactions and initial results of the Expo have been fruitful. The Shanghai Trading Group's intended turnover has ranked first in the national local trading groups for eight consecutive years. The scale of this exhibition has reached a new high. As an important part of the Shanghai Trading Group, the large retail buyers' alliance has grown from 21 to 45 members, practicing "buying in Shanghai, selling globally". A group of key procurement project representatives carried out on-site promotion, focusing on the introduction of imported high-quality consumer goods, and fully released the spillover effect of the Expo. According to incomplete statistics, the retail alliance has reached 72 purchasing intentions at this Expo.

story.title_zh: 从每周一美元二毛，到钢铁大王
story.title_en: From a Dollar Twenty a Week to Steel
story.body_zh: 卡内基十三岁移民美国，第一份工每周挣一美元二毛。当电报信童时，他背下全城商户的名字和脸。二十几岁把全部身家压进钢铁，建成世界最大钢铁厂。晚年捐出九成财产。
story.body_en: Andrew Carnegie arrived in America from Scotland at thirteen. His first job paid one dollar and twenty cents a week. As a messenger boy, he memorized every business in town. In his thirties he bet everything on steel, built the largest steel company in the world, then gave away ninety percent of it.

lines.en: Pittsburgh, eighteen fifty. A thirteen year old Scottish immigrant starts his first job. It pays one dollar and twenty cents a week.
lines.zh: 匹兹堡，1850 年。一个十三岁的苏格兰移民开始第一份工作，周薪一美元二毛。

lines.en: Boy, the telegraph office needs a messenger. Can you learn the streets?
lines.zh: 小子，电报局要个信童。你能把街巷记熟吗？

lines.en: I will learn more than the streets, sir. I will learn every business in town, and every face behind the door.
lines.zh: 先生，我记的不只是街巷。我要记住全城每一家商户，和每扇门后面的每张脸。

lines.en: While other boys played, he drilled himself on the telegraph key, and became the fastest ear in the city.
lines.zh: 别的孩子去玩了，他对着电报机日夜苦练，成了全城收发电报最快的人。

lines.en: Save it, invest it early, and when you find your industry, bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 把钱存下来，早一点投出去。找到属于自己的行业时，就把全部身家押上去。

lines.en: He built the largest steel company in the world. Then he gave ninety percent of it away, with one line for the history books. Dying rich is a disgrace.
lines.zh: 他建成了世界最大的钢铁公司，然后捐出了九成财产，只留给历史一句话：带着巨富死去，是一种耻辱。

joke.title_zh: 我是靠卖得太早赚的钱
joke.title_en: I Made My Fortune by Selling Too Early
joke.body_zh: 罗斯柴尔德家族的男爵说过一句反直觉的话：我是靠卖得太早，才赚到钱的。人人都怕卖早了少赚，可他偏偏说卖早是美德。背后的道理是：没人能卖在最高点，总想赚最后一分钱的人，往往连本带利还回去。留给读者一个问题：你手里的盈利，是因为贪心多等了几天，还是因为纪律提前落袋？
joke.body_en: Baron Rothschild said something that sounds backwards. I made my fortune by selling too early. Everyone fears selling too soon and missing the top. He called selling early a virtue. The logic is simple. Nobody sells at the exact peak. People who chase the last penny usually return everything, and more. So here is a question worth thinking about. Your last winning trade. Did you hold longer out of greed, or exit early out of discipline?

items.title_zh: 报道：OpenAI完成110亿美元新融资，估值1.25万亿美元，软银、红杉资本等参投
items.body_zh: 据知情人士透露，OpenAI已完成约110亿美元的新融资，这是本轮估值1.25万亿美元融资的首笔部分。 资金已于周五划入公司账户。本轮剩余部分——总额可能增至最高200亿美元——预计将在未来数周内完成。 在推迟了首次公开募股（IPO）计划后，这家AI开发商已就一轮大额融资洽谈了一个多月。OpenAI最初计划以1.4万亿美元估值融资300亿美元或更多，随后在AI板块遭遇公开市场暴跌的背景下缩减了计划。
items.title_en: Report: OpenAI raises $11 billion, valued at $1.25 trillion, with participation from SoftBank, Sequoia Capital, and others.
items.body_en: OpenAI has closed about $11 billion in new funding, the first part of a $1.25 trillion round, according to people familiar with the matter. Funds were transferred to the company's account on Friday. The remainder of this round - which could total up to $20 billion - is expected to be completed in the coming weeks. The AI developer has been negotiating a large funding round for more than a month after postponing plans for an initial public offering (IPO). OpenAI, which initially planned to raise $30 billion or more at a $1.4 trillion valuation, later scaled back its plans against the backdrop of a public-market plunge in the AI sector.

items.body_zh: 商务部新闻发言人就美制裁中国企业答记者问。 问：美东时间11月5日，美国务院宣布制裁两家中国企业。有消息称，这是美首次以涉古巴为由对中国企业实施制裁。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美方以涉及第三方为由，对中国企业采取单边制裁，违反国际法和国际关系基本准则，中方对此坚决反对。
items.title_en: the Ministry of Commerce responded to "the first time the United States has sanctioned a Chinese enterprise for involving Cuba": urging the United States to correct its wrongdoing as soon as possible.
items.body_en: a spokesman for the Ministry of Commerce replied to reporters about the US sanctions on Chinese companies. Q: On November 5, the State Council announced sanctions against two Chinese companies. Sources said that this is the first time the United States has imposed sanctions on Chinese companies on the grounds of involving Cuba. What is China's comment on this? A: We are aware of the situation. China firmly opposes the imposition of unilateral sanctions on Chinese enterprises by the United States on the grounds that they involve third parties, in violation of international law and the basic norms governing international relations.

items.title_en: International gold prices fell on off-farm days, rising 5% this week, and copper in New York fell 3.8% this week.
items.body_en: At the end of New York on Friday (November 6), spot gold fell 0.4% to $4,071.39 per ounce. The Asia-Pacific morning market had briefly risen slightly, and it has continued to decline since 09:17 Beijing time. At 21:30, the US non-farm payroll employment report fell significantly, refreshing as low as $4,028.49, rising 5.06% this week. items.title_zh: 道明证券：预计2027年美国高评级债券发行将达创纪录的2.4万亿美元
items.body_zh: 道明证券预测，在人工智能（AI）相关支出增加、并购活动以及再融资/赎回需求上升的推动下，2027年美国投资级公司债券发行量将达创纪录的2.4万亿美元。 美国信贷策略师Hans Mikkelsen在一份报告中写道：“异常强势的‘蓝色浪潮’意味着数据中心建设将面临更多阻力。因此，尽管我们此前曾考虑将2027年美国投资级债券发行量上调5000亿美元，现在我们将其收窄至3000亿美元。
items.title_en: TD Securities: US High Rating Bond Issuance Expected to Reach Record $2.4 Trillion in 2027.
items.body_en: TD Securities forecasts a record $2.4 trillion in U.S. investment-grade corporate bond issuance in 2027, driven by increased artificial intelligence (AI) -related spending, merger and acquisition activity, and rising refinancing/redemption demand. “An unusually strong ‘blue wave‘ means more headwinds for data center construction,” US credit strategist Hans Mikkelsen wrote in a note. So, while we had previously considered raising our 2027 U.S. investment grade bond issuance by $500 billion, we are now narrowing it down to $300 billion.

items.title_zh: 美国多名国会议员说将推动撤销不合理关税政策
items.body_zh: 11月7日消息，鉴于美国选民对高生活成本和高通胀反应强烈，随着民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，多名民主党籍国会议员表示将致力于推动撤销现行的不合理关税政策。尽管这些民主党籍国会议员表达了推动撤销不合理关税措施的意愿，但也有分析认为，虽然民主党在中期选举中获得国会参议院和众议院的控制权，但美国总统特朗普可以通过对国会立法行使否决权等进行有效制衡，现有关税措施短期内或难以出现实质性松动。（新华社）
items.title_en: US lawmakers say they will push for the removal of unjustified tariffs.
items.body_en: On Nov. 7, as voters reacted strongly to the high cost of living and high inflation in the United States and as Democrats scored a landslide victory in the midterm elections, a number of Democratic lawmakers expressed their commitment to pushing for the removal of the current unjustified tariffs. Although these Democratic members of Congress have expressed their willingness to push for the withdrawal of unreasonable tariff measures, some analysts believe that although Democrats have gained control of the Senate and House of Representatives in the mid-term elections, US President Trump can effectively check and balance the existing tariff measures by exercising veto power over Congressional legislation, etc. It may be difficult to see substantive loosening in the short term. (Xinhua News Agency).

items.body_en: Luo Xu, GM's global senior vice president and president of GM's China and Asian markets, said at the 9th China International Import Expo that the Expo provides a platform for GM to communicate with Chinese consumers and showcase the results of cooperation with China. items.title_zh: 中奥企业家委员会首次会议在京举行
items.body_zh: 11月6日，商务部与奥地利联邦经济、能源和旅游部在北京共同主办中国—奥地利企业家委员会首次会议。王文涛部长与哈特曼斯多费尔部长出席会议并致辞，中奥两国政经界代表100余人参会。王文涛表示，今年是中奥建交55周年，在两国领导人战略引领下，中奥双方秉持开放包容理念，推动双边经贸合作取得丰硕成果。双方共同成立中奥企业家委员会，将为两国经济界搭建双向奔赴的桥梁，推动中国“十五五”规划和奥地利《工业战略2035》深入对接。
items.title_en: The first meeting of the China-Austria Entrepreneurs Committee was held in Beijing.
items.body_en: On November 6, the Ministry of Commerce and the Austrian Federal Ministry of Economy, Energy and Tourism co-hosted the first meeting of the China-Austria Entrepreneurs Committee in Beijing. Minister Wang Wentao and Minister Hartmannsdorfer attended the meeting and delivered speeches, and more than 100 representatives of the political and economic circles of China and Austria attended the meeting. Wang Wentao said that this year marks the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Austria. Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, China and Austria have upheld the concept of openness and inclusiveness and promoted bilateral economic and trade cooperation to achieve fruitful results. The two sides jointly established the China-Austria Entrepreneurs Committee, which will build a two-way bridge for the economic circles of the two countries and promote the in-depth integration of China's 15th Five-Year Plan and Austria's Industrial Strategy 2035.

items.body_zh: 第七届世界媒体峰会先导片《AI赋能，共赴新程》11月7日正式发布。影片融合实景拍摄、历史影像与AIGC生成画面，以人工智能时代媒体发展与全球媒体合作为切入点，围绕“技术如何改变媒体、媒体如何坚守新闻本质、全球媒体如何携手应对新时代挑战”展开表达。影片将新华社建社95周年、第七届世界媒体峰会与人工智能时代媒体的新使命融为一体，展现全球媒体携手应对技术变革、共同守护新闻价值、共同开创未来的愿景。（新华社）
items.title_en: The 7th World Media Summit pilot film "AI Empowerment, Together for a New Journey" was officially released.
items.body_en: The pilot film of the 7th World Media Summit "AI Empowerment, Going to a New Journey" was officially released on November 7. The film combines real-life shooting, historical images and AIGC-generated images, and takes the development of media in the era of artificial intelligence and global media cooperation as the starting point, focusing on "how technology changes media, how the media adheres to the nature of news, and how the global media work together to meet the challenges of the new era". The film integrates the 95th anniversary of Xinhua News Agency and the 7th World Media Summit with the new mission of media in the era of artificial intelligence, showing the vision of global media to jointly cope with technological changes, jointly safeguard news values, and jointly create the future. (Xinhua News Agency).

items.title_zh: 平均成功率91%！苹果研究团队披露机器人“大脑”进展：调用千问模型在宇树G1上验证
items.body_zh: 当地时间11月4日，苹果研究团队在预印本平台arXiv提交论文《Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation》，披露了人形机器人自主控制系统HALO。研究团队将该系统部署在宇树科技的G1人形机器人上进行验证，让机器人将在仿真环境中学到的动作，带到陌生的现实房间中执行。 研究团队还公开了数据生成、模型训练和部署代码，涵盖动作生成、动作跟踪、任务编排以及仿真和真实机器人运行等环节。
items.title_en: 91% average success rate! Apple Research Team Reveals Robot “Brain” Progress: Calling the Thousand-Question Model to Validate on Yushu G1.
items.body_en: On November 4, local time, Apple's research team submitted the paper "Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation" on the preprint platform arXiv, disclosing the humanoid robot autonomous control system halo. The research team deployed the system on Yushu Technology's G1 humanoid robot for verification, allowing the robot to take the actions learned in the simulation environment to an unfamiliar reality room for execution. The research team also exposed data generation, model training, and deployment code, covering motion generation, motion tracking, task orchestration, and simulation and real robot operation.

story.era: 美国 · 伯克希尔副手
story.title_zh: 倒过来想，总是倒过来想
story.body_zh: 芒格不喜欢问怎么成功，他喜欢问怎么失败。有人问他怎么把投资做好，他说：先列出所有让人亏钱的方法，然后一辈子别碰。巴菲特说，是芒格把他从捡烟蒂变成了买好公司。
story.body_en: Charlie Munger rarely asked how to succeed. He asked how to fail. List every way to lose money, then avoid all of it, forever. Buffett said Munger moved him from cheap stocks to great businesses.

lines.en: Every year, thousands of investors make the pilgrimage to Omaha. Most of them come for two men, not one.
lines.zh: 每年都有成千上万的投资者去奥马哈朝圣。他们大多是为两个人来的，不是一个人。

lines.en: Mr. Munger, how do I become a great investor?
lines.zh: 芒格先生，我怎样才能成为优秀的投资者？

lines.en: Wrong question. Ask me how to be a terrible one.
lines.zh: 问题就问错了。你应该问我，怎么变成一个糟糕的投资者。

lines.en: All right then. How do I lose all my money?
lines.zh: 行吧，那我怎么才能把钱全亏光？

lines.en: Easy. Use leverage. Chase rumors. Buy what is hot. Pretend you understand. Then avoid all of it, forever.
lines.zh: 太简单了。加杠杆、听消息、追热门、不懂装懂。然后一辈子都别碰这些。

lines.en: Buffett once said Munger pushed him from cheap stocks to wonderful businesses. Cheap is not enough. A cheap, wonderful business is the goal.
lines.zh: 巴菲特说，是芒格把他从捡烟蒂推向了买好公司。便宜不是终点，便宜的好生意才是。

joke.title_zh: 过去五次衰退，经济学家预测中了九次
joke.title_en: Nine of the Last Five Recessions
joke.body_zh: 经济学家萨缪尔森讲过一个流传至今的玩笑：股市在过去五次衰退里，预测中了九次。意思是股市总在喊狼来了，喊的次数远比狼真的来的次数多。所以听到谁信誓旦旦地预测崩盘，不用太紧张，也不用太得意，先数一数他之前喊过几次。预测市场这件事，连最聪明的人也常常只是运气好。
joke.body_en: The economist Paul Samuelson left us a joke that never gets old. The stock market has predicted nine of the last five recessions. Read that again. Nine predictions. Five real recessions. The market cries wolf far more often than the wolf arrives. So when someone loudly predicts the next crash, stay calm. Count how many times they called it before. Predicting the market is hard. Even for the smartest people in the room.

items.body_zh: 微软公司正逐步终止向甲骨文公司租用人工智能（AI）算力的安排，这是其对价值数十亿美元的云合作伙伴关系进行更大范围重估的一部分。 据知情人士透露，近几个月来，微软在拒绝续约后，已开始陆续关闭从甲骨文租用的算力。随着时间推移，微软租用的这批算力变得不再好用，因为它已不再符合公司的规格要求。他们称，甲骨文这批硬件使用的是英伟达较旧一代的芯片。
items.title_en: Report: Deprecated chips are not new enough, Microsoft is winding down arrangements to lease AI cloud power from Oracle.
items.body_en: Microsoft is winding down its arrangement to lease artificial intelligence (AI) computing power from Oracle as part of a broader revaluation of its multi-billion-dollar cloud partnership. In recent months, Microsoft has begun shutting down the computing power leased from Oracle after refusing to renew the contract, according to people familiar with the matter. Over time, this batch of computing power rented by Microsoft has become no longer easy to use because it no longer meets the company's specifications. The Oracle hardware, they say, uses older Nvidia chips.

items.body_zh: 巴西批准了首份关键与战略矿产清单，这是新国家政策的一部分，旨在吸引投资、扩大国内加工能力，以回应西方国家日益增长的资源需求——后者希望减少对中国的依赖。 这份包含27种矿产的清单于周四在”关键与战略矿产国家工业化委员会”（简称CIMCE）的首次会议上获批，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦出席了会议。政府希望利用巴西丰富的矿产资源，在本土建设更多加工与制造能力，而非主要以原材料形式出口。
items.title_en: Brazil puts rare earths at the heart of its key mineral strategy.
items.body_en: Brazil has approved its first list of key and strategic minerals as part of a new national policy aimed at attracting investment and expanding domestic processing capacity in response to the growing demand for resources in Western countries, which want to reduce their dependence on China. The list of 27 minerals was approved on Thursday at the inaugural meeting of the Committee for the Industrialization of Critical and Strategic Mineral States (CIMCE), attended by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The government hopes to use Brazil's abundant mineral resources to build more processing and manufacturing capacity at home, rather than exporting mainly in the form of raw materials.

story.title_zh: 在大崩盘里亏光的人，写出了投资教科书
story.title_en: The Man Who Lost It All in 1929, Then Wrote the Textbook
story.body_zh: 格雷厄姆年轻时是华尔街的明星，一九二九年股灾来了，他加了杠杆的账户几乎归零。痛苦让他想通了一件事：预测市场靠不住，能靠的只有价格和价值的差距。后来他写出《证券分析》，提出安全边际——用五毛钱买一块钱的东西。
story.body_en: Benjamin Graham was a rising star on Wall Street. Then came the crash of nineteen twenty-nine. His leveraged account was almost wiped out. The pain taught him one thing. You can only rely on the gap between price and value. He wrote Security Analysis, and invented the margin of safety. Buy a dollar for fifty cents.

lines.en: New York, autumn, nineteen twenty-nine. The party on Wall Street is about to end.
lines.zh: 纽约，1929 年秋。华尔街这场狂欢，马上就要散场了。

lines.en: Benjamin Graham was a rising star. He used borrowed money, and he was sure he was right.
lines.zh: 本杰明·格雷厄姆是当红新星，他借钱加杠杆，自以为万无一失。

lines.en: Mr. Graham, the market is falling every day. What do we do now?
lines.zh: 格雷厄姆先生，市场天天在跌，我们现在怎么办？

lines.en: Hold on. It has to come back. It always comes back.
lines.zh: 再撑一撑，会回来的，一直都回来的。

lines.en: It did not come back fast enough. His account was almost wiped out. It took him years to recover.
lines.zh: 可它回来得太慢了。他的账户几乎归零，用了好几年才缓过来。

lines.en: I was wrong about one thing. You cannot predict the market. You can only measure the gap between price and value.
lines.zh: 我想明白一件事：预测市场靠不住。能靠的，只有价格和价值之间的差距。

lines.en: So he wrote the book that fed generations of investors. His rule is famous. Buy a dollar for fifty cents.
lines.zh: 于是他写出了那本养活几代投资者的书。规则很有名：用五毛钱，买一块钱的东西。

joke.title_zh: 地上有一张十美元，经济学家为什么不捡
joke.title_en: Why Economists Never Pick Up Money
joke.body_zh: 两个经济学家走在街上，看见地上躺着一张十美元。年轻的说，快去捡。老的说，不可能，如果是真的，早就被人捡走了。这是对有效市场理论最经典的调侃：所有信息都已经反映在价格里，天上不会掉馅饼。玩笑归玩笑，它也留了个真实的尾巴——市场大多数时候确实很有效，但偶尔，地上的钱是真的。
joke.body_en: Two economists walk down the street. They spot a ten dollar bill on the ground. The young one says, pick it up. The old one says, it cannot be real. If it were real, someone would have picked it up already. This is the classic joke about efficient markets. All information is already in the price. Free money does not lie on the street. But here is the twist. Markets are efficient most of the time. Only most. Once in a while, the money on the ground is real.
